v4.9.074 - an empty answer no longer redraws the screen (#349)

The log showed it plainly: every pull said "untouched by the answer: 11" - it
had been handed nothing at all - and then rebuilt the whole storyboard and
redrew the page anyway. That is what tore down whatever was on top: an expanded
card, a photograph just taken, the story-flow view. The view MODE never changed,
which is why #342 and #347 did not stop it.

A delta with no frames, versions, pictures, settings or deletions now takes the
new watermark, so the device counts as up to date, and leaves the screen alone.

Also #348: the "Synced - kept 2 local frames" popup is gone. Fine when a pull
was rare; since #320 made a pull follow every push it became a message every few
seconds on top of the work. It goes to the log instead.

And the push now NAMES the settings it considers unsent. "project settings
changed - sending" appears on every push with nothing else changing, which means
one item is never confirmed and the device pushes for ever. This says which.
